narrative.title: Pulling One Car Off the Train
narrative.scenario: A parcel train's cars are chained one-way, and a manifest update demands that the x-th car (counted from 1) be uncoupled. Crews can only relink couplings — the car before the target must connect straight to the car after it, and the lead car is special because nothing precedes it. Report the train once the car is gone.
narrative.inputFormat: An array arr of node values, and an integer x, the 1-based position of the node to delete.
narrative.outputFormat: The list after removing the x-th node, read front to back.
constraints: 2 <= arr.length <= 10^5 (a non-empty list remains after deletion)

testCases.explanation: The third car is the tail; uncoupling it just leaves the first two cars.
Removing the second car relinks 1 directly to 2, skipping 5.

hintLevels: Level 1: Deletion in a one-way chain means relinking the predecessor — except at the head, where the list simply starts one node later.
Level 2: If x is 1, return head.next. Otherwise walk to node x-1 and set its next to the node after the target.
Level 3: Walk exactly x-2 steps from the head to reach the predecessor (positions are 1-based); off-by-one here silently deletes the wrong car.
